narrator.name: George
narrator.why: Warm British storyteller — narrative_story tag. Slightly slower for verse.

april.name: Sarah
april.why: Mature, reassuring, composed — April is the teacher, not a child.

mango.name: Jessica
mango.why: Playful, bright, warm — Mango is the fastest learner, voice leans forward.

fern.name: Lily
fern.why: Velvety British, careful — Fern is the cautious tree frog, lines land soft and clipped.

riddle.name: Laura
riddle.why: Quirky, sassy — Riddle is the parrot who asks why after every call.

dusty.name: Roger
dusty.why: Laid-back, resonant — Dusty is the steady wombat, monosyllables and strong stresses.

laurel.name: Matilda
laurel.why: Knowledgeable, upbeat American — Laurel appears in chapter 9 through April's retelling, warm mentor register.

chorus.name: Sarah
chorus.why: Same as April — for moments where all four friends respond together ('We hear you, April!'), we'll use chorus tag and render in April's voice as a neutral group voice; alternative is to render per-character and overlap in ffmpeg, but that adds complexity for limited gain in a children's book.
